name: ReadXmlFromFileNode
label: Read XML from File
description: Reads the contents of an XML file into a variable.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The path to the XML file.

fields.name: EncodingType
fields.label: Encoding Type
fields.description: Specifies the encoding to use for reading the XML file.

selectOptions.label: Unicode (UTF-16)
selectOptions.description: Uses UTF-16 encoding with a BOM (Byte Order Mark).

selectOptions.label: Big Endian Unicode
selectOptions.description: Uses UTF-16 encoding without a BOM.

selectOptions.label: UTF-8 (No BOM)
selectOptions.description: Uses UTF-8 encoding without a BOM.

fields.name: XmlDocument
fields.label: XML Document Loaded
fields.description: Returns the parsed XmlDocument object if the XML file was successfully read and parsed.
